NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS (APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION AND
TRANSFER) RULES, 1989
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS (APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION AND
TRANSFER) RULES, 1989
(Amendment of R.10)
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 24th December, 2005]
NO.
SOR-VI(E&AD)1-3/2003(Vol. V), dated 3-7-2003.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 26
of the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P. Act
No.XVIII of 1973), read with this Department's Notification
No.SOR.1(S&GAD)1-206/74/Vol.V, dated 18th April, 1989, the Chief Minister
N.-W.F.P. is pleased to direct that in the North-West Frontier Province Civil
Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1989, the following
further amendment shall be made, namely.--
In rule 10, in
sub-rule (2), the following proviso shall be added at the end, namely:
"Provided that
nothing contained in this sub-rule shall apply to the household staff of the
Chief Minister's House Peshawar, Frontier House Islamabad, Frontier Rest House
Bannu, Swat and Abbottabad, Frontier House Nathiagali and Shahi Mehman Khana,
Peshawar and any other House to be established by the Government.
